notes.title: Update #1 - Additional Movement Controls(Arrow Keys)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today, I have added additional Controls for the player's movement. Previously, you were able to control the player using WASD controls. But now, you can use arrow keys along with WASD keys to control the player's movement. I hope it will be helpful to you.

If you have further suggestions or if you found a bug, please let me know either through the discussions section or through the contact email. Thanks to your patience!

I will provide more updates in the future and make changes to the game according to the community feedback.

Check out my other game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/897420/The_Christmas_Gifts/

Best Regards,
Anamik
